arabic text: Maula haq imam ya Hassan ya hussain
english translation text: Maula is truth—the Imam—O Hasan, O Hussain

arabic text: Wo aabide beemar tha, Chalne se jo lachaar tha\nAur shaam ka bazaar tha, Aur mustafa ki betiyaa
english translation text: He was the ailing worshipper, too weak even to walk\nAnd there stood the marketplace of Shaam, with the daughters of Mustafa

arabic text: Shabbir ki wo laadli, Sine pe jo shah ke pali\nJiski abaa ban me jali, Moo per tamacho ke nishaa
english translation text: She was Shabbir's beloved, raised upon the King's chest\nHer cloak was burned in the wilderness, and her face bore marks of slaps

arabic text: Shaame gharibaa aaghayi, Aabid ko ghairat khaagayi\nPehre pe zainab aaghayi, Abbas or Akber kaha
english translation text: The night of the bereaved arrived, and Abid was consumed by anguish\nZainab stood guard, crying: where are Abbas and Akbar?

arabic text: Roker kahe qassim ki maa, Mara gaya qassim jawaan\nAy laal mei dhundhu kaha, Bewa ka tha jo aasra
english translation text: Weeping, Qasim's mother said: my young Qasim has been killed\nO son, where shall I search for you, the only support of this widow?

arabic text: Qassim jawaan mara ghaya, Pamaal bhi lasha huwa\nShehne kiye tukre jamaa, Roti rahi qassim ki maa
english translation text: Young Qasim was killed and his body was trampled\nThe King gathered his pieces while Qasim's mother wept

arabic text: Wo asghare besheer tha, Aur hurmala ka teer tha\nPyasa ghala kyu kar kata, Royi zamee aur aasmaa
english translation text: He was the infant Asghar, and it was Hurmala's arrow\nWhy was his thirsty throat pierced? The earth and heavens wept

arabic text: Pyaase gale khanjar chale, Chaader chini khaime jale\nAbbas ke parcham tale, Rokar kahe ye bibiya
english translation text: Daggers moved upon the thirsty throat, veils were snatched and tents were burned\nBeneath Abbas's standard, the ladies cried

arabic text: Teero pe tha laasha tera, Aur jism tha khoo se bhara\nJab aaya khaali zuljana, Peyro se lipti bibiya
english translation text: Your body lay pierced by arrows and drenched in blood\nWhen Zuljanah returned without you, the ladies clung to his feet

arabic text: Maula haq imam ya Hassan ya hussain
english translation text: Maula is truth—the Imam—O Hasan, O Hussain
